session_enterprise_metadata_check.name: session_enterprise_metadata_check
session_enterprise_metadata_check.value:
(
    ("session"."enterprise_grant_id" is null and "session"."enterprise_identity_id" is null
      and "session"."auth_epoch" is null and "session"."auth_method" is null)
    or ("session"."enterprise_grant_id" is not null and "session"."enterprise_identity_id" is not null
      and "session"."auth_epoch" is not null and "session"."auth_epoch" >= 0
      and "session"."auth_method" is not null and char_length("session"."auth_method") between 1 and 64
      and "session"."auth_method" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+$')
  )

enterprise_dm_deliveries_lifetime_check.name: enterprise_dm_deliveries_lifetime_check
enterprise_dm_deliveries_lifetime_check.value:
isfinite("enterprise_dm_deliveries"."created_at") and isfinite("enterprise_dm_deliveries"."expires_at") and "enterprise_dm_deliveries"."expires_at" > "enterprise_dm_deliveries"."created_at"
    and ("enterprise_dm_deliveries"."first_attempt_at" is null or (isfinite("enterprise_dm_deliveries"."first_attempt_at") and "enterprise_dm_deliveries"."first_attempt_at" >= "enterprise_dm_deliveries"."created_at"))
    and ("enterprise_dm_deliveries"."sent_at" is null or (isfinite("enterprise_dm_deliveries"."sent_at") and "enterprise_dm_deliveries"."sent_at" >= "enterprise_dm_deliveries"."created_at"))

enterprise_event_inbox_state_fields.name: enterprise_event_inbox_state_fields
enterprise_event_inbox_state_fields.value:
(
        "enterprise_event_inbox"."state" = 'pending'
        and "enterprise_event_inbox"."claim_owner" is null
        and "enterprise_event_inbox"."lease_until" is null
        and "enterprise_event_inbox"."completed_at" is null
      ) or (
        "enterprise_event_inbox"."state" = 'leased'
        and "enterprise_event_inbox"."claim_owner" is not null
        and "enterprise_event_inbox"."claim_owner" ~ '[^[:space:]]'
        and "enterprise_event_inbox"."lease_until" is not null
        and "enterprise_event_inbox"."completed_at" is null
      ) or (
        "enterprise_event_inbox"."state" = 'done'
        and "enterprise_event_inbox"."claim_owner" is null
        and "enterprise_event_inbox"."lease_until" is null
        and "enterprise_event_inbox"."completed_at" is not null
      )

enterprise_event_inbox_pairing_digest_me.name: enterprise_event_inbox_pairing_digest_message
enterprise_event_inbox_pairing_digest_me.value: "enterprise_event_inbox"."pairing_token_digest" is null or ("enterprise_event_inbox"."message_id" is not null and "enterprise_event_inbox"."message_id" ~ '[^[:space:]]')

enterprise_login_grants_binding_check.name: enterprise_login_grants_binding_check
enterprise_login_grants_binding_check.value:
"enterprise_login_grants"."deployment_role" in ('development','test','production','canary')
    and "enterprise_login_grants"."purpose" = 'login' and "enterprise_login_grants"."identity_version" > 0 and "enterprise_login_grants"."auth_epoch" >= 0
    and "enterprise_login_grants"."generation" > 0 and "enterprise_login_grants"."flow_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    and char_length("enterprise_login_grants"."scope") between 1 and 256 and "enterprise_login_grants"."scope" ~ '[^[:space:]]'

enterprise_challenges_binding_check.name: enterprise_challenges_binding_check
enterprise_challenges_binding_check.value:
"enterprise_challenges"."deployment_role" in ('development','test','production','canary')
    and "enterprise_challenges"."purpose" = 'login' and "enterprise_challenges"."generation" > 0 and "enterprise_challenges"."identity_version" > 0
    and "enterprise_challenges"."flow_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "enterprise_challenges"."failed_attempts" between 0 and 5

enterprise_challenges_lifetime_check.name: enterprise_challenges_lifetime_check
enterprise_challenges_lifetime_check.value:
isfinite("enterprise_challenges"."created_at") and isfinite("enterprise_challenges"."expires_at") and isfinite("enterprise_challenges"."secret_expires_at")
    and "enterprise_challenges"."expires_at" = "enterprise_challenges"."created_at" + interval '300 seconds'
    and "enterprise_challenges"."secret_expires_at" >= "enterprise_challenges"."created_at" and "enterprise_challenges"."secret_expires_at" <= coalesce("enterprise_challenges"."recover_until", "enterprise_challenges"."expires_at")
    and ("enterprise_challenges"."state" <> 'active' or "enterprise_challenges"."secret_expires_at" = "enterprise_challenges"."expires_at")
    and ("enterprise_challenges"."state" <> 'consumed' or "enterprise_challenges"."secret_expires_at" = "enterprise_challenges"."recover_until")

enterprise_challenges_consumption_check.name: enterprise_challenges_consumption_check
enterprise_challenges_consumption_check.value:
(
    ("enterprise_challenges"."consumed_at" is null and "enterprise_challenges"."recover_until" is null)
    or ("enterprise_challenges"."consumed_at" is not null and "enterprise_challenges"."recover_until" is not null
      and isfinite("enterprise_challenges"."consumed_at") and isfinite("enterprise_challenges"."recover_until")
      and "enterprise_challenges"."consumed_at" >= "enterprise_challenges"."created_at" and "enterprise_challenges"."consumed_at" < "enterprise_challenges"."expires_at"
      and "enterprise_challenges"."recover_until" = "enterprise_challenges"."consumed_at" + interval '90 seconds'))
    and ("enterprise_challenges"."state" <> 'consumed' or "enterprise_challenges"."consumed_at" is not null)
    and ("enterprise_challenges"."state" <> 'active' or "enterprise_challenges"."consumed_at" is null)

enterprise_challenges_secret_check.name: enterprise_challenges_secret_check
enterprise_challenges_secret_check.value:
(
    ("enterprise_challenges"."code_hmac" is not null and "enterprise_challenges"."hmac_key_id" is not null and "enterprise_challenges"."secret_cleared_at" is null
      and "enterprise_challenges"."code_hmac" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "enterprise_challenges"."hmac_key_id" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}$')
    or ("enterprise_challenges"."code_hmac" is null and "enterprise_challenges"."hmac_key_id" is null and "enterprise_challenges"."secret_cleared_at" is not null
      and isfinite("enterprise_challenges"."secret_cleared_at") and "enterprise_challenges"."secret_cleared_at" >= "enterprise_challenges"."secret_expires_at"))
    and ("enterprise_challenges"."state" <> 'active' or "enterprise_challenges"."code_hmac" is not null)

enterprise_login_budgets_lifetime_check.name: enterprise_login_budgets_lifetime_check
enterprise_login_budgets_lifetime_check.value:
isfinite("enterprise_login_budgets"."window_started_at") and isfinite("enterprise_login_budgets"."expires_at")
    and "enterprise_login_budgets"."expires_at" > "enterprise_login_budgets"."window_started_at" and ("enterprise_login_budgets"."next_allowed_at" is null or isfinite("enterprise_login_budgets"."next_allowed_at"))

enterprise_pairings_binding_check.name: enterprise_pairings_binding_check
enterprise_pairings_binding_check.value:
"enterprise_pairings"."deployment_role" in ('development','test','production','canary')
    and "enterprise_pairings"."purpose" = 'login' and "enterprise_pairings"."generation" > 0
    and "enterprise_pairings"."flow_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and "enterprise_pairings"."token_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
    and char_length("enterprise_pairings"."tenant_key") between 1 and 256 and "enterprise_pairings"."tenant_key" ~ '[^[:space:]]'
    and char_length("enterprise_pairings"."app_id") between 1 and 256 and "enterprise_pairings"."app_id" ~ '[^[:space:]]'

enterprise_pairings_confirmation_check.name: enterprise_pairings_confirmation_check
enterprise_pairings_confirmation_check.value:
(
    ("enterprise_pairings"."confirmed_at" is null and "enterprise_pairings"."confirmed_message_id" is null and "enterprise_pairings"."confirmed_identity_version" is null)
    or ("enterprise_pairings"."confirmed_at" is not null and "enterprise_pairings"."confirmed_message_id" is not null and "enterprise_pairings"."confirmed_identity_version" is not null
      and "enterprise_pairings"."intended_identity_id" is not null and "enterprise_pairings"."confirmed_identity_version" > 0
      and char_length("enterprise_pairings"."confirmed_message_id") between 1 and 256 and "enterprise_pairings"."confirmed_message_id" ~ '[^[:space:]]'))
    and ("enterprise_pairings"."state" <> 'pending' or "enterprise_pairings"."confirmed_at" is null)
    and ("enterprise_pairings"."state" <> 'confirmed' or "enterprise_pairings"."confirmed_at" is not null)

enterprise_pairings_lifetime_check.name: enterprise_pairings_lifetime_check
enterprise_pairings_lifetime_check.value:
isfinite("enterprise_pairings"."created_at") and isfinite("enterprise_pairings"."expires_at") and isfinite("enterprise_pairings"."retain_until")
    and "enterprise_pairings"."expires_at" = "enterprise_pairings"."created_at" + interval '120 seconds'
    and ("enterprise_pairings"."confirmed_at" is null or (isfinite("enterprise_pairings"."confirmed_at") and "enterprise_pairings"."confirmed_at" >= "enterprise_pairings"."created_at" and "enterprise_pairings"."confirmed_at" < "enterprise_pairings"."expires_at"))
    and "enterprise_pairings"."retain_until" = coalesce("enterprise_pairings"."confirmed_at" + interval '390 seconds', "enterprise_pairings"."expires_at")

enterprise_notification_outbox_fields_ch.name: enterprise_notification_outbox_fields_check
enterprise_notification_outbox_fields_ch.value:
("enterprise_notification_outbox"."destination_email" is null or (char_length("enterprise_notification_outbox"."destination_email") between 1 and 320
        and "enterprise_notification_outbox"."destination_email" !~ '[[:space:]]'))
        and char_length("enterprise_notification_outbox"."destination_version") between 1 and 256
        and "enterprise_notification_outbox"."destination_version" !~ '[[:space:]]'
        and char_length("enterprise_notification_outbox"."recipient_name") between 1 and 256
        and char_length("enterprise_notification_outbox"."device") between 1 and 512
        and char_length("enterprise_notification_outbox"."source") between 1 and 512
        and char_length("enterprise_notification_outbox"."app_name") between 1 and 256
        and "enterprise_notification_outbox"."app_url" ~ '^https?://[^?#[:space:]]+$'

enterprise_notification_outbox_lifetime_.name: enterprise_notification_outbox_lifetime_check
enterprise_notification_outbox_lifetime_.value:
isfinite("enterprise_notification_outbox"."login_at")
        and isfinite("enterprise_notification_outbox"."available_at")
        and isfinite("enterprise_notification_outbox"."created_at")
        and isfinite("enterprise_notification_outbox"."expires_at")
        and "enterprise_notification_outbox"."expires_at" > "enterprise_notification_outbox"."created_at"
        and "enterprise_notification_outbox"."expires_at" <= "enterprise_notification_outbox"."created_at" + interval '31 days'

enterprise_notification_outbox_terminal_.name: enterprise_notification_outbox_terminal_check
enterprise_notification_outbox_terminal_.value:
(
        "enterprise_notification_outbox"."state" in ('pending','sending','failed')
          and "enterprise_notification_outbox"."sent_at" is null
          and "enterprise_notification_outbox"."skipped_at" is null
      ) or (
        "enterprise_notification_outbox"."state" = 'sent'
          and "enterprise_notification_outbox"."sent_at" is not null
          and "enterprise_notification_outbox"."skipped_at" is null
      ) or (
        "enterprise_notification_outbox"."state" = 'skipped'
          and "enterprise_notification_outbox"."sent_at" is null
          and "enterprise_notification_outbox"."skipped_at" is not null
      )

feishu_login_codes_hold_check.name: feishu_login_codes_hold_check
feishu_login_codes_hold_check.value:
("feishu_login_codes"."state" = 'active'
      and "feishu_login_codes"."email" is not null and "feishu_login_codes"."open_id" is not null
      and "feishu_login_codes"."display_name" is not null and "feishu_login_codes"."code_hmac" is not null)
    or ("feishu_login_codes"."state" <> 'active'
      and "feishu_login_codes"."email" is null and "feishu_login_codes"."open_id" is null
      and "feishu_login_codes"."display_name" is null and "feishu_login_codes"."code_hmac" is null)
